COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin). There is also mild renal impairment (creatinine high), elevated INR, and mild liver enzyme (alkaline phosphatase) elevation. These findings suggest a systemic inflammatory response, possible infection or sepsis, and multi-organ involvement. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
